en: So, you found my hideaway. The volcano swallowed my old Gym, and now I keep my fire in a cave of ice.
But a Leader's fire doesn't go out with a building. A Champion from Johto, is it? Then let's turn up the heat!
My flames are out, for now. You've earned this: the Volcano Badge.
{player} received the Volcano Badge from Blaine!
And take this, too. It holds my hottest move.
TM50 is Overheat. It's fearsomely strong, but it leaves the user's Special Attack much lower afterwards.
One day I'll build my Gym on Cinnabar again. Until then, the ice keeps my fire honest.
Hey, champ in the making! Blaine's Pokémon burn hot. Water and Ground moves will cool them right down.
You beat Blaine! The ice in here nearly melted!
